labels.label: L1
labels.receiver: thread::spawn(move || { // Sender needs the shared mutex. { let (lock, cvar) = &*shared_s; let mut ready = lock.lock().unwrap(); *ready = true; cvar.notify_all(); } // Send on the channel. tx1.send(1).unwrap(); // Wait for the receiver to acknowledge completion. let _ = rx2.recv(); })

labels.label: L6
labels.receiver: thread::spawn(move || { // Wait until the sender has released the shared mutex before // blocking on the channel, so the receiver never blocks on the // channel while holding the lock the sender needs. { let (lock, cvar) = &*shared_r; let mut ready = lock.lock().unwrap(); while !*ready { ready = cvar.wait(ready).unwrap(); } } // Receive from the channel without holding the shared lock. let _ = rx1.recv(); // Acknowledge completion to the sender. let _ = tx2.send(1); })
